branch_note: F4 and F5 concern additional biological interpretation; F1-F3 can resolve feasibility of the observed-prediction inputs first. F6 follows admitted definitions and must not turn these options into selected sample sizes.

items.feasibility_task: Source joins and eligibility desk assessment
items.required_material_or_access: Stock/reference access; original culture/well/image/plate/dilution map; molecular registry; outcome-access log.
items.suggested_expertise: Data steward, microbial geneticist and statistician.
items.decision_changed_by_smallest_deliverable: Join completeness and eligibility of independent units can be decided without more endpoint acquisition.
items.refusal_condition: Unavailable joins or known source outcomes may restrict source to training/design.

items.required_material_or_access: Known-introduction identity and earlier fate channel; matched resident/scaffold state; independent blinded reference, positive and negative events.
items.suggested_expertise: Imaging scientist, microbial ecologist and statistician.
items.decision_changed_by_smallest_deliverable: Can an earlier event be observed with usable error/unknown bounds independently of terminal recovery?
items.refusal_condition: Observer and terminal readout share the same invisible-loss mechanism; no independent truth or bound.

items.required_material_or_access: Traceable input at named entry stage; route/context/phase challenge frame; wrong/ambiguous/unrecovered outputs and technical-parent map.
items.decision_changed_by_smallest_deliverable: Which exact downstream stages are calibrated and can routewise predictors be formed?
items.refusal_condition: Entry totals are uncertain or a late control is used to calibrate earlier stages.

items.required_material_or_access: Independent parental/child molecular truth, event/reference carriers and event-type catalogue; imaging/collection loss ledger.
items.suggested_expertise: Molecular geneticist, lineage-methods specialist and bioinformatician.
items.decision_changed_by_smallest_deliverable: Are origin-positive and inherited origin-negative references available before undertaking a large sequencing/calling programme?
items.refusal_condition: Only aggregate mutation-rate agreement, retrospective survival-selected genomes or reporter state exists.

items.required_material_or_access: Route/allele/state key from R27; target/source context and marker comparison; independent mismatch evidence.
items.decision_changed_by_smallest_deliverable: Which bounds are scientifically defensible, and which biological claims must remain unavailable?
items.refusal_condition: Unmeasured density, timing, medium or background mismatch is declared negligible.

items.required_material_or_access: Admitted predictor definitions, independent-unit law, plausible nuisance ranges, inaccessible endpoint allocation and full comparator requirements.
items.suggested_expertise: Statistician, numerical reviewer and operations owner.
items.decision_changed_by_smallest_deliverable: Can precision, costs, storage, instrument time and fixed collection be jointly justified before freezing?
items.refusal_condition: Power assumes oracle truth or sample count is fixed before measuring ascertainment/dependence.
